players.product: memory packaging and test (DRAM / NAND, modules)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results by site (H2 2026 shareholder meeting deck): the Korean parent (separate basis) grew revenue 60.7% year on year and 46.1% quarter on quarter to KRW 421.7 billion, with memory up 22% year on year in a gradual recovery, system-semiconductor packaging such as large-body packages up 47.1% and merchandise sales to overseas subsidiaries up 71%; Vietnam revenue rose 57% year on year and 7% quarter on quarter to KRW 252.3 billion, as Vina (Bac Giang) raised monthly turnkey output from 55 million units (June 2025) to 72 million (June 2026) and the Bac Ninh plant grew 36% on fabless volumes; Brazil revenue rose 364% year on year and 137% quarter on quarter to KRW 272.5 billion, which the company calls a quantum jump driven by rising memory prices
quarterly_data.figure: parent Q2 revenue KRW 421.7 billion (+60.7% YoY); Vietnam KRW 252.3 billion (+57% YoY); Brazil KRW 272.5 billion (+364% YoY); Vina turnkey output 72 million units a month (June 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: H2 2026 outlook: at the parent, memory revenue is expected to grow versus H1 on the capacity expansion, system-semiconductor revenue to rise on a packaging-line expansion, and mobile AP test volumes to increase; in Vietnam, DRAM and SSD volumes are expected to keep growing on customer demand, with DRAM turnkey orders expanding to production of more than 100 million units in December
quarterly_data.figure: Vina DRAM turnkey production expected above 100 million units in December 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Vietnam capacity plan: Vina (Bac Giang) turnkey memory packaging capacity to rise from 0.7 hundred million units (Q4 2025) to 1.04 hundred million units (Q4 2026); the Bac Ninh plant is expanding its cleanroom from 800 pyeong to 2,700 pyeong (completion scheduled for September) and moving equipment from the Korean head office, while broadening products from fingerprint-sensor packages to FCBGA and QFN. In Brazil the memory module line is to be expanded from a current capacity of 2.5M to 5M
quarterly_data.figure: Vina turnkey capacity 0.7 hundred million units (Q4 2025) to 1.04 hundred million (Q4 2026); Bac Ninh cleanroom 800 to 2,700 pyeong; Brazil module capacity 2.5M to 5M

quarterly_data.signal: Brazil (HT Micron) product plan: supply of server DRAM is starting, an LPDDR5x uMCP for mobile is to be commercialised in October, and DDR5 sales are expanding to a new customer (company D); the Brazilian unit aims to secure DDR5, LPDDR5 and V9 NAND supply smoothly during the memory shortage, to broaden its brand line-up from DDR5, SSD and MCP to MCM and SiP, and to spend 5% of revenue on R&D in next-generation packaging (3D, hybrid bonding)
quarterly_data.figure: LPDDR5x uMCP launch October 2026; server DRAM supply starting

quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging roadmap: a 2.5D package on its HIC packaging platform targeting the on-device market, with development to be completed in 2026 and mass production targeted for 2028; large-body packages (80x80) for data centres and HPC and AI networking products, pursued through domestic foundry-linked orders; a CPO module developed with proprietary process technology under a national project with the Korea Electronics Technology Institute; and an MCM for AI appliances and robots targeted for mass production in 2029. The company also joins a government FOWLP testbed (led by the Korea Photonics Technology Institute) to localise 12-inch FOWLP process technology
quarterly_data.figure: 2.5D HIC package mass production target 2028; MCM mass production target 2029; large body 80x80

quarterly_data.signal: Head-office line 5 under review: a new cleanroom building of 2,000 to 3,000 pyeong (up to three floors) with groundbreaking at the end of 2026, completion at the end of 2027 and full operation in 2028. Long-term vision: become a global top-5 OSAT by 2030 (ranked 8th in 2025, 18th in 2015), with Korea, Vietnam and Brazil as its three global bases, memory-centred growth, test business expansion and next-generation packaging (2.5D and chiplet, bridge die, CPO module, SiC power module)
quarterly_data.figure: line 5 cleanroom 2,000 to 3,000 pyeong, full operation 2028; target global OSAT rank 5 by 2030 (8th in 2025)
